units.source_text: 薰中纳言遣人将红叶送给二女公子时，正值匂亲王在家。

en.t: When Middle Counselor Kaoru sent someone to deliver maple leaves to the Second Princess, Prince Niou happened to be at her house.

units.source_text: 侍女漠不关心地送进去，说道：“这是南邸送来的。”

en.t: A maid carried them in without much interest and said, “These came from the southern residence.”

units.source_text: 二女公子以为照例是谈情的信，非常担心，然而此时岂能隐藏。

en.t: The Second Princess assumed it was, as usual, a love letter and was very anxious, but at this moment how could she hide it?

units.source_text: 匂亲王含有意义似的说道：“好漂亮的红叶啊！”便取过来看。

en.t: Prince Niou said meaningfully, “What beautiful maple leaves!” and took them to look at them.

units.source_text: 但见薰中纳言的信中写道：“尊处近日想必平安无事。

en.t: He saw that Middle Counselor Kaoru’s letter said, “I trust that all has been peaceful with you recently.

units.source_text: 小生前日曾赴宇治山乡，山中朝雾困人，更增伤感。

en.t: The other day I went to the mountain village at Uji, where the morning mist in the hills oppressed me and deepened my melancholy.

units.source_text: 详情他日面罄。

en.t: I shall tell you the details fully when we meet another day.

units.source_text: 该地山庄改造佛殿之事，已嘱咐阿阇梨照办。

en.t: As for converting the villa there into a Buddhist hall, I have already asked the ajari to see it carried out.

units.source_text: 曾蒙金诺，故敢将庄屋移建他处。

en.t: Since I once had your gracious consent, I have ventured to move the estate building to another place.

units.source_text: 应有事宜，即请吩咐老尼弁君可也。”

en.t: If anything is needed, please simply give instructions to the old nun Ben no Kimi.”

units.source_text: 匂亲王看罢说道：“这封信写得好堂皇啊！

en.t: After reading it, Prince Niou said, “This letter is written in a remarkably grand manner!

units.source_text: 大约他知道我在这里吧。”

en.t: He probably knows that I am here.”

units.source_text: 薰中纳言或许多少确有几分此种心理，二女公子看见信中并无别事，心中正在欣慰，听见匂亲王说这种猜疑的话，认为冤枉太甚，不胜怨恨，那娇嗔之相非常可爱。

en.t: Middle Counselor Kaoru may indeed have had some such thought, but the Second Princess had just been relieved to see that the letter contained nothing else; when she heard Prince Niou speak with such suspicion, she felt terribly wronged and resentful, and her pouting anger was extremely charming.

units.source_text: 即使有万种罪状，也不怕人不容赦了。

en.t: Even if she had been guilty of countless offenses, she would not have needed to fear being unforgiven.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对她说：“你写回信吧。

en.t: Prince Niou said to her, “Write a reply.

units.source_text: 我不看就是了。”

en.t: I will simply not look.”

units.source_text: 便背转身子向着别处。

en.t: He then turned his back and faced another direction.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得过分撒娇坚不肯写，教人看作古怪，便执笔写道：“闻君走访山乡，令人不胜欣羡！

en.t: The Second Princess thought that if she indulged herself too much and stubbornly refused to write, people would find it strange, so she took up the brush and wrote, “Hearing that you visited the mountain village fills me with envy!

units.source_text: 该地庄屋改造佛殿，诚属至善。

en.t: To convert the estate building there into a Buddhist hall is truly the best possible thing.

units.source_text: 将来我身出家，不须另觅岩穴，自有归宿之处。

en.t: In the future, when I take religious vows, I will not need to seek some other cave among the rocks, for I will already have a place to go.

units.source_text: 而旧居亦不致日渐荒芜。

en.t: And my former dwelling will also be spared from gradually falling into ruin.

units.source_text: 多承美意，无任感戴。”

en.t: I am deeply grateful for your kindness.”

units.source_text: 照这回信看来，两人交谊纯属普通友爱，无可指责之处。

en.t: Judging from this reply, the friendship between the two of them was merely ordinary affection, with nothing blameworthy about it.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王生性好色，以己度人，大概认为两人之间定有异乎寻常的关系而很不放心吧。

en.t: But Prince Niou was lustful by nature and judged others by himself, so he probably believed that there must be some unusual relationship between them and felt very uneasy.
